_meta.title: labmate.tools · Panel Designer seed data
notes: Instrument presets are published DEFAULT / example configurations. Real instruments are frequently re-filtered by core facilities: every preset must be editable and users should check against their own instrument.
Filters are written center/width (e.g. 530/30 = 515-545 nm). LP = longpass (lower cut only). For Cytek Aurora the channel lo/hi edges are given directly.

Fluor peaks (exMax/emMax) are vendor-published maxima. They are for labels, sorting and sanity checks only; spillover must be computed from full spectra (planned source: FPbase, CC BY-SA 4.0 - attribution and share-alike apply to derived spectra files).
status: 'source' = taken from the cited document; 'verify' = commonly cited value not yet checked against a primary source in this pass.

userEntries.note: Custom instruments and fluors are stored on the user's device (localStorage key labmate.panelDesigner.v1 → custom.instruments / custom.fluors) with origin 'user'. They use exactly the same shape as presets, so a user entry can later be submitted and promoted to a preset after checking.
instrumentFields: basedOn? (preset id it was copied from)
userEntries.rule: A fluor with only peaks is drawn as an approximate curve and every number it touches is marked APPROX.
